items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Steve was interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 25, 2019 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Steve was interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 25, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Steve Buckingham on campus today at Hamilton College. Thanks for being here.
It’s nice to be here, in a blizzard or whatever this is.
